config.query: FROM customer_leads_prod | WHERE age < 18 OR country == "GDPR_Restricted_Zone" | STATS minors_count = COUNT(CASE(age < 18, 1, NULL)), restricted_count = COUNT(CASE(country == "GDPR_Restricted_Zone", 1, NULL)), total_risky = COUNT(*) | EVAL is_risky = CASE(total_risky > 0, true, false) | KEEP minors_count, restricted_count, total_risky, is_risky
